mapper.select: SELECT v.tool_version_id AS version_id, v.version_no, v.status, v.revision, v.published_at, v.last_update_time, ( v.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND v.version_no = MAX(v.version_no) FILTER (WHERE v.status = 'PUBLISHED') OVER () ) AS current FROM squad_chat.sq_tool_version v WHERE v.tool_id = #{toolId} ORDER BY v.version_no DESC

SELECT v.tool_version_id, t.tool_id, t.tool_code, t.tool_name, t.tool_type, v.exposed_name, v.description, v.version_no, (v.version_no = MAX(v.version_no) OVER (PARTITION BY v.tool_id)) AS latest FROM squad_chat.sq_tool_version v JOIN squad_chat.sq_tool t ON t.tool_id = v.tool_id LEFT JOIN squad_chat.sq_mcp_server_version mv ON mv.mcp_server_version_id = v.mcp_server_version_id LEFT JOIN squad_chat.sq_mcp_server m ON m.mcp_server_id = mv.mcp_server_id WHERE v.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND t.status = 'ENABLED' AND ( v.mcp_server_version_id IS NULL OR (mv.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND m.status = 'ENABLED') ) ORDER BY t.tool_code, v.version_no DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE squad_chat.sq_tool_version SET exposed_name = #{exposedName}, description = #{description}, input_schema = #{inputSchema, typeHandler=com.agentsquad.squad.v2.config.JsonbTypeHandler}, read_only = #{readOnly}, implementation_key = #{implementationKey}, mcp_server_version_id = #{mcpServerVersionId}, remote_tool_name = #{remoteToolName}, http_spec = #{httpSpec, typeHandler=com.agentsquad.squad.v2.config.JsonbTypeHandler}, revision = revision + 1, last_updater_id = #{lastUpdaterId}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tool_id = #{toolId} AND tool_version_id = #{toolVersionId} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND revision = #{revision}
